Official Release Date
The official release date for BreakFest is set for March 22 2019. We have gone back and fourth with the dates because our steam page was set up at the last minute, whoops. Plus, this is our first game so expect more in the future, you can follow us on Twitter for more updates.

Press Release
If you are a YouTube, blogger, reviewer, curator and you want to check out BreakFest. Now Is The Time! If you are interested or have any question, you can contact us at Storm1475@outlook.com
